review_type: controlled local Mock reliability boundary audit

findings.title: Concurrent review preflight does not deduplicate commits
findings.observation: Both JVMs pass pending checks before either delegates; ordered release yields exit 0 for both, revision 2 and two review logs.
findings.recommendation: Keep the declared serial prototype boundary; require server-side expected-state/version checks plus idempotency/result lookup before claiming concurrent safety.

findings.title: Full tag PUT loses an intervening addition despite matched readback
findings.observation: B commits the original three tags plus 轻松 after A's last check; A overwrites with the original three plus 悬疑 and reports matched.
findings.recommendation: Server-side version/If-Match or atomic add; no local transaction or unconditional retry.

findings.title: Active-tag validation is based on the plan-time library
findings.observation: A controlled work-copy fixture deprecates 悬疑 after planning; execute still adds it. The current CLI has no library-write command.
findings.recommendation: State the timing limitation and validate within the server update if submission-time validity is required.

findings.title: Repeated shading changes archive identity without payload changes in the observed adjacent pair
findings.observation: The adjacent archived pair has equal entry payloads and different entry ordering; final JAR SHA differs from the task2 historical SHA.
findings.recommendation: Freeze the final candidate and preserve historical hashes; separately assess jar.forceCreation/outputTimestamp and verify reproducibility.

scope_caveat: P1 becomes a release blocker if production concurrent writes or submission-time tag validity are required. No such guarantee is claimed by this serial Mock prototype.
